confidence_notes: I estimated the food and drink anchors from aggregated cost-of-living web results for Faro. These include Expatica, which draws on Numbeo data as of June 2026, and other cost-of-living aggregators. I converted them at an approximate EUR/USD rate of about 1.10 and raised them slightly for the July peak season. Inexpensive meals are about EUR 12.5, mid-range meals for two about EUR 40, cappuccino about EUR 1.6-1.8 and a 0.5L draught beer about EUR 2.5-3.1. I did not find a reliable direct figure for cocktails or wine. I estimated those from the local price relationship to beer and typical Algarve bar prices, so they are less certain. The accommodation figures are holistic estimates from general knowledge for July high season in the Algarve. I did not check them against any booking data, and they are the least certain anchors because summer demand drives large price swings. The FX observation is the RBA figure for 18 November 2026 (0.6720 USD per AUD). It came from a web-search summary that cited the RBA exchange-rates pages, not from a direct read of the RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Faro is a mid-sized regional capital and tourist gateway in southern Portugal. Restaurant prices run slightly above the Portuguese national average and below Lisbon. Summer accommodation demand resembles other Algarve towns such as Lagos and Albufeira, though Faro is somewhat cheaper.
